key_concepts: Objects can be compared by size, weight, and volume.
Some objects are bigger or smaller than others.
Weight can be compared as heavier or lighter.
Volume can be compared as larger or smaller.
Solids have their own shape and can be held.
Liquids have the ability to flow.
Liquids differ in how fast they flow.
Adding water to a thick liquid can make it flow faster.
Materials can be described by color, texture, and odor.
A balance can show whether objects are equal in weight.
